subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Flavure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Flavure'** is not a meaningful word. It's likely to be **'Flavour'**.
 
• **Flavour**__**:** The distinctive taste of a food or drink.
 __
 
• **E.g.**__- The yoghurt comes in eight fruit **flavours**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Figure**__**: A****n amount (in numbers) or a price {राशि (संख्‍या में) या मूल्‍य}**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The unemployment **figures** are lower this month.
 
 
 
• __**Leisure**__**: The time when you do not have to work** **(समय जिसमें काम नहीं करना होता)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- Shorter working hours mean that people have more **leisure**.
 
 
 
• ​__**Future**__: **T****he time that will come after the present (वर्तमान के बाद का समय; भविष्‍य)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- Who knows what will happen in the **future**?

The correct answer is **'Admire'**.
